title: Field Guide: Ordering Food & Restaurant Adjustments

words.English Meaning: a cup of / a glass of
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 我想要一杯热茶。(Wǒ xiǎng yào yì bēi rè chá.) — I'd like a cup of hot tea.
请给我来一碗牛肉面。(Qǐng gěi wǒ lái yì wǎn niúròu miàn.) — Please bring me a bowl of beef noodles.

words.English Meaning: a portion of / an order of
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 我们要一份煎饺。(Wǒmen yào yí fèn jiānjiǎo.) — We want an order of pan-fried dumplings.
我想要一瓶矿泉水。(Wǒ xiǎng yào yì píng kuàngquán shuǐ.) — I'd like a bottle of mineral water.
我想要一份菜单，谢谢。(Wǒ xiǎng yào yí fèn càidān, xièxie.) — I would like a menu, thank you.
这碗面请不要辣。(Zhè wǎn miàn qǐng bú yào là.) — Please make this bowl of noodles not spicy.
我们点微辣的汤底。(Wǒmen diǎn wēi là de tāngdǐ.) — We order the mildly spicy soup base.
这杯奶茶请少冰。(Zhè bēi nǎichá qǐng shǎo bīng.) — Less ice for this milk tea, please.
请帮我做一杯去冰的红茶。(Qǐng bāng wǒ zuò yì bēi qù bīng de hóngchá.) — Please make me a cup of black tea with no ice.
水要常温的，谢谢。(Shuǐ yào chángwēn de, xièxie.) — I'd like room temperature water, thanks.
我要一杯热的拿铁咖啡。(Wǒ yào yì bēi rè de nátiě kāfēi.) — I want a hot latte.
请问是堂食还是外带？(Qǐngwèn shì tángshí háishì wàidài?) — Excuse me, is it dine-in or takeout?
我们在这里吃。(Wǒmen zài zhèlǐ chī.) — We are eating here.
请稍等，菜马上就来。(Qǐng shāoděng, cài mǎshàng jiù lái.) — Please wait a moment, the dishes will arrive shortly.
请问你们有什么忌口吗？(Qǐngwèn nǐmen yǒu shénme jìkǒu ma?) — Do you have any dietary restrictions?
先点这些，够了，谢谢。(Xiān diǎn zhèxiē, gòu le, xièxie.) — That's enough for now, thanks.
您好，还要别的吗？— 不要了。(Nín hǎo, hái yào bié de ma? — Bú yào le.) — Anything else? — Nothing else, thanks.
请问饮品需要什么甜度？(Qǐngwèn yǐnpǐn xūyào shénme tiándù?) — What sweetness level would you like for your beverage?
绿茶一杯，半糖少冰。(Lǜchá yì bēi, bàn táng shǎo bīng.) — One green tea, half sugar and less ice.
麻烦给我们几张纸巾。(Máfan gěi wǒmen jǐ zhāng zhǐjīn.) — Could you please give us some napkins?
这碗牛肉粉请不加香菜。(Zhè wǎn niúrǒufěn qǐng bù jiā xiāngcài.) — Please do not add cilantro to this beef noodle soup.
服务员，麻烦帮我们加汤。(Fúwùyuán, máfan bāng wǒmen jiā tāng.) — Waiter, could you please refill our soup?
面里免葱，谢谢师傅。(Miàn lǐ miǎn cōng, xièxie shīfu.) — Omit scallions in the noodles, thanks chef.
你好，请问在哪里结账？(Nǐ hǎo, qǐngwèn zài nǎlǐ jiézhàng?) — Hello, where do I settle the bill?
请问可以分单付款吗？(Qǐngwèn kěyǐ fēndān fùkuǎn ma?) — Can we split the bill to pay?
